supply.leakage_control: same-period area and target-derived yield_proxy are excluded from predictors

time_series_selection.selection: dense recent expanding-window rolling origin on pre-holdout training data only
time_series_selection.final_holdout: most recent 4 quarters for supply; most recent 12 months for price
time_series_selection.stability_summary: median and 90th-percentile rolling sMAPE; worst fold retained as diagnostic only

demand.training: sample_weight=RFACT passed to model.fit(); target and survey weight excluded from predictors
demand.model_race: GB vs Huber-GB vs log1p-GB vs XGB vs regularized-XGB vs Poisson-HistGB; selected by 3-fold province+target-quantile stratified CV inside the training partition
demand.final_holdout: stratified 25% household holdout reserved until candidate family is selected
demand.mase_baseline: province-mean naive (cross-sectional FIES has no time axis)
demand.verdict_bands: USABLE_PROXY (weighted R2>=0.45 or WAPE<=30%), INDICATIVE_PROXY (weighted R2>=0.20 or WAPE<=55%), INSUFFICIENT_DATA otherwise
demand.temporal_proxy: FIES baseline + LFS economic activity + seasonal affordability; supply seasonality is context only and is not multiplied into demand pressure

validation.supply_price: rolling-origin model selection on training history + independent chronological final holdout
validation.demand_household_proxy: stratified CV model selection + untouched household holdout + province leave-one-out + weighted aggregate error + per-target validation_report.md
